<rect x="597" y="97" width=" 
      .mainText { 
        animation: 
          revealText 1.4s cubic-bezier(.16,1,.3,1) forwards, 
          breathe 5s ease-in-out 2.2s infinite; 
        transform-origin: 500px 145px; 
      } 
 
      .ghost { 
        animation: ghostIn 1.5s ease-out forwards; 
      } 
 
      .subtitle { 
        animation: subtitleIn 1s ease-out 1.5s forwards; 
        opacity: 0; 
      } 
 
      .scanner { 
        animation: scan 2.2s cubic-bezier(.65,0,.35,1) 0.5s forwards; 
      } 
 
      .scannerGlow { 
        animation: scanGlow 2.2s cubic-bezier(.65,0,.35,1) 0.5s forwards; 
      } 
 
      .particle1 { 
        animation: particle 3s ease-in-out 1.7s infinite; 
      } 
 
      .particle2 { 
        animation: particle 4s ease-in-out 2s infinite; 
      } 
 
      .particle3 { 
        animation: particle 3.5s ease-in-out 2.3s infinite; 
      } 
 
      .ui { 
        animation: uiIn 1s ease-out 1.8s forwards; 
        opacity: 0; 
      } 
 
      .indicator { 
        animation: blink 2s ease-in-out 2s infinite; 
      } 
 
      @keyframes revealText { 
 
        0% { 
          opacity: 0; 
          transform: scale(1.18); 
          filter: blur(14px); 
          letter-spacing: 18px; 
        } 
 
        35% { 
          opacity: 0.65; 
          filter: blur(5px); 
        } 
 
        70% { 
          opacity: 1; 
          filter: blur(0); 
          letter-spacing: 11px; 
        } 
 
        100% { 
          opacity: 1; 
          transform: scale(1); 
          filter: blur(0); 
          letter-spacing: 9px; 
        } 
 
      } 
 
      @keyframes breathe { 
 
        0%, 100% { 
          transform: scale(1); 
        } 
 
        50% { 
          transform: scale(1.012); 
        } 
 
      } 
 
      @keyframes ghostIn { 
 
        0% { 
          opacity: 0; 
          letter-spacing: 20px; 
          filter: blur(10px); 
        } 
 
        45% { 
          opacity: 0.08; 
        } 
 
        100% { 
          opacity: 0.025; 
          letter-spacing: 9px; 
          filter: blur(0); 
        } 
 
      } 
 
      @keyframes subtitleIn { 
 
        0% { 
          opacity: 0; 
          transform: translateY(8px); 
        } 
 
        100% { 
          opacity: 1; 
          transform: translateY(0); 
        } 
 
      } 
 
      @keyframes scan { 
 
        0% { 
          transform: translateX(-70px); 
          opacity: 0; 
        } 
 
        10% { 
          opacity: 1; 
        } 
 
        90% { 
          opacity: 1; 
        } 
 
        100% { 
          transform: translateX(1070px); 
          opacity: 0; 
        } 
 
      } 
 
      @keyframes scanGlow { 
 
        0% { 
          transform: translateX(-100px); 
          opacity: 0; 
        } 
 
        15% { 
          opacity: 0.7; 
        } 
 
        85% { 
          opacity: 0.7; 
        } 
 
        100% { 
          transform: translateX(1100px); 
          opacity: 0; 
        } 
 
      } 
 
      @keyframes particle { 
 
        0%, 100% { 
          opacity: 0.15; 
          transform: translateY(0); 
        } 
 
        50% { 
          opacity: 0.9; 
          transform: translateY(-7px); 
        } 
 
      } 
 
      @keyframes uiIn { 
 
        0% { 
          opacity: 0; 
          transform: translateY(5px); 
        } 
 
        100% { 
          opacity: 1; 
          transform: translateY(0); 
        } 
 
      } 
 
      @keyframes blink { 
 
        0%, 100% { 
          opacity: 0.25; 
        } 
 
        50% { 
          opacity: 1; 
        } 
 
      }
